import sys, random, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from protocol import parse_request
from main import build_versions, compute_runs
rng=random.Random(5)
runs=64
initial=[["::/0",0]]
for i in range(runs-1):
    initial.append(["%032x/128"%(i+1), i+1])
transactions=[]
for v in range(1):
    tx=[]
    for i in range(runs-1):
        if rng.random()<0.5: tx.append(['erase', "%032x/128"%(i+1)])
        else: tx.append(['set', "%032x/128"%(i+1), rng.randint(0,100)])
    transactions.append(tx)
case={'initial':initial,'transactions':transactions,'bursts':[],'cache_pages':12,
      'costs':{'hit':1,'miss':17,'decode':[0,1,2]}}
cases=parse_request(json.dumps({'cases':[case]}).encode())
vs=build_versions(cases[0])
for v in vs:
    s,h=compute_runs(v)
    print('runs',len(s), 'hops', h[:5])
